A Minecraft server plugin that allows players to manually control the shape and connection of stair blocks. It uses Crouch + Right Click to cycle through all available stair shapes (Straight, Inner Left, Inner Right, Outer Left, and Outer Right), allowing for custom geometry that usually defies standard Minecraft physics.
